summary.highest_priority_finding: The parent-death / orphan-MCP-server lifecycle guard (939c5ca8 and descendants) has recurred as a production bug 4 separate times (#982, #1101, #1100, plus open PR #987) specifically because the original guard was Linux/Bun-only. DECISIONS-r3 Q6 now builds the WAL-checkpoint-on-close logic (#988) on top of that same guard. Unless GP8 (checkpoint) and GP9 (parent-kill) are both verified on real Windows CI, v2 risks baking the 4-times-recurring gap into two load-bearing subsystems at once.
